verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs say Pro Plan users can connect bank accounts and have transactions automatically imported, merged, and categorized into bookkeeping, which is an ongoing feed rather than a one-off import. The story also asks for credit-card accounts and a daily cadence, and neither is documented. The feature is limited to the paid Pro tier, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit credit-card account connection, a documented daily or recurring sync schedule, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts in seconds with the Pro Plan. Transactions will appear in your bookkeeping automatically
With the Pro Plan, automatically import, merge, and categorize your bank transactions.
